question: Should the Wave 2+ modular dashboard roadmap remain bundled OpenClaw Control UI/Gateway work, or should optional widget/gallery/app/skill slices move to plugin, skill, or ClawHub ownership?
rationale: The issue crosses product direction, custom widget sandboxing, write-back persistence, install/publish trust, role visibility, and plugin API boundaries that cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep Bundled Roadmap
options.body: Keep this tracker open and review the linked child issues and PRs one by one with explicit security, storage, and plugin-boundary decisions.

options.title: Move Optional Slices Outward
options.body: Retain only generic core/API seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widget packs, skills, registries, or tab-app bundles to ship through plugin or ClawHub paths.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Wave 2
options.body: Pause or close the roadmap and associated PR stack if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboard expansion is not current product work.

recommendation.title: Keep Bundled Roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this tracker open and review the linked child issues and PRs one by one with explicit security, storage, and plugin-boundary decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main adjacent owner signal for the plugin-tab precedent and security-sensitive Control UI plugin surfaces.
